title: VaultTec — Phase 4e Trend-Following Test Report
method: Trend-following test on the three FRESH windows (FRESH-1/2/3) from Phase 4d, using the cached real Yahoo Finance histories only — no new fetch. Entry: buy when close > SMA-20 and SMA-20 > SMA-50, history up to the trade day only, no look-ahead. Exits: baseline (3% stop / 4.5% target / 10 days), wide-5 (5% / 7.5% / 10 days), wide-6 (6% / 9% / 10 days). Every trade through the real PaperTradingEngine and Risk Engine, balanced profile, $10,000 virtual cash, long-only, 5-day walk-forward steps.
data_source: yfinance (delayed real market data, free — Yahoo Finance) — cached copies in data/fresh-cache/
entry_rule: Buy when close > 20-day SMA AND 20-day SMA > 50-day SMA, on history up to the trade day only. No trade when either average is not yet defined.
verdict_rule: A variant 'holds up' when its pooled fresh-window paper P&L is > $0 AND its pooled win rate is > 40% (the 1.5:1 break-even) AND it is positive in at least 2 of the 3 fresh windows.

limits: None of FRESH-1/2/3 is a falling window like OOS-2 (Feb-Aug 2025), so this run cannot prove trend-following does better in a falling market — that needs OOS-2, whose histories are not cached and would need a fresh Yahoo fetch. Three windows are still past prices: nothing here proves future profits, and live paper trades over real days plus a compliance/legal review are still required before any real money is considered.
